summary: Master intelligence-led policing and threat assessment. Learn the SARA model, OSINT, and link analysis to drive proactive law enforcement. Register today.
lede: Intelligence-led policing uses data analysis and crime intelligence to guide proactive decisions about threats and interventions. For intelligence analysts, operations planners, commanders and threat-assessment specialists, the course covers managing the intelligence cycle, gathering and verifying open-source information, and using link analysis and risk matrices to inform collection plans and operational responses.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals within law enforcement, national security, and corporate intelligence functions who are responsible for identifying and mitigating complex threats.
audience: Security Intelligence Managers in the private sector
modules: The Intelligence Cycle and Collection Management
Open Source Intelligence and Digital Footprints
Analytical Techniques for Crime Pattern Analysis
Threat Assessment Frameworks and Risk Matrices
prerequisites: You should have at least two years of experience in a law enforcement, security, or analytical role. Familiarity with basic investigative techniques and standard office software is required. Prior exposure to the intelligence cycle is beneficial but not mandatory.
